verdict.rationale: The only support is a marketing claim on the Ubuntu Desktop page. It says that, as a lightweight and efficient OS, installing Ubuntu on older hardware can improve performance and extend device lifespan. No technical documentation, hardware requirements, or hands-on reports back this up, and community remarks about GNOME being slow or Ubuntu feeling bloated are too general to count as a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: minimum or recommended hardware requirements for older machines, guidance on lightweight flavours or settings for low-spec devices, benchmarks, independent or hands-on corroboration of performance gains on older hardware.
